newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Thermo Bio, Willis.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Thermo Bio, Willis.

text.p: Thermo BioAnalysis Corp and Willis Lease Finance Corp made their stock market debuts Wednesday in the shadow of the skyrocketing IPO of International Network Systems.

Shares of Thermo BioAnalysis fell 1/8 to 13-7/8 from their IPO price of $14. NatWest Securities was the lead underwriter of the deal, which raised about $20 million. The company makes instruments and information management systems used in biochemical research and production.

Willis Lease shares rose 5/8 to 8-5/8. The shares were priced at the low end of the estimated range of $8 to $10. The company provides operating leases for spare commercial aircraft engines to commercial airlines, aircraft manufacturers and repair facilities.
Wedbush Morgan Securities was the lead underwriter of the offering of two million shares.
International Network Systems overshadowed both. The IPO jumped 14-1/2 to 30-1/2.
